title: The Sparkle Hands
summary: Unarmed hits grant Lightning Charges, which improve attacks against metal targets.

fields.Conductive Strikes: Gain 2 Lightning Charges on an unarmed hit, including Throw attacks. Multiple damage instances can generate charges more than once.
fields.Effective Transmitter: While charged, attacks against metal Constructs and metal-armoured foes have advantage. Spell attack rolls qualify.
fields.Lightning Charges: While charged, +1 to attack rolls and +1 Lightning damage. At 5 charges, the next qualifying damage adds 1d8 Lightning and consumes the charges. Lose one per turn. Lightning-resistant targets do not take the flat +1 Lightning damage.
fields.Acquisition: Chest at the base of a giant stump in the Sunlit Wetlands.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
